budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received 50 percent of its American Rescue Plan Act funds, printed as $614,000 in municipal funds.
budget_items.quote: the town has received 50 percent of funds from the american rescue plan act, which was $614,000 in municipal funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The county allocation was determined to be $2,279,580, with 50 percent to be paid directly to the town by about August 16, 2021; printed alongside the $614,000 figure without reconciliation.
budget_items.quote: there was a determination that the county allocation comes out to $2,279,580, 50 percent of which will be paid directly to the town by or around august 16, 2021 with no request process.

budget_items.topic: Chapter 90 funds and Pavement Management Plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW reported $628,000 in Chapter 90 funds still to be spent and gave the Pavement Management Plan as about $526,000 to $270,000, including the drainage portion for debt exclusion, as printed.
budget_items.quote: mr. oliva informed the committee there are $628,000 in chapter 90 funds still to be spent, and the pavement management plan is at about $526,000 to $270,000 including the drainage portion for debt exclusion.

budget_items.topic: DPW large tractor with rotary mower
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW said it needs a large tractor with a rotary mower for roadside vegetation, which will probably cost more than $160,000.
budget_items.quote: mr. oliva stated the dpw needs a large tractor with a rotary mower to efficiently handle roadside vegetation, and will probably cost more than $160,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An upgrade to the flail mower would cost $30,000 but would not be the right tool for the job.
budget_items.quote: mr. oliva replied that one would cost $30,000, but would not be the right tool for the job.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A committee member said the city of Worcester received ARPA funds and is spending a sum on its parks; figures are about another municipality.
budget_items.quote: the city of worcester received $110 million in arpa funds, and is spending $10 million on their parks.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee's proposed procedure covers off-budget spending in excess of $20,000.
budget_items.quote: proposed procedure on off budget spending in excess of $20,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Because the applicants withdrew, the article passed at the last Town Meeting will be rescinded and $66,500 becomes free cash to be appropriated by the Town Manager.
budget_items.quote: the article passed at the last town meeting will be rescinded and the $66,500 will become free cash to be appropriated by the town manager.
